skills.name: Fix spelling and grammar
skills.description: Correct language mistakes without unnecessary rewriting.
skills.prompt:
Correct spelling, grammar, punctuation, capitalization, and obvious language mistakes.

Preserve the original meaning, tone, structure, terminology, and level of formality as much as possible.

Do not rewrite sentences purely for stylistic preference. Only make changes that improve linguistic correctness or resolve clearly awkward phrasing caused by an error.

skills.name: Improve clarity
skills.description: Make content clearer, more concise, and easier to understand.
skills.prompt:
Rewrite the content to make it clearer, more concise, and easier to understand.

Remove unnecessary words, repetition, vague phrasing, filler, and overly complicated sentence structures.

Prefer direct, concrete language and natural sentence flow.

Preserve all important meaning, nuance, facts, terminology, links, and relevant details. Do not simplify away information that is necessary to understand the content.

Do not substantially change the tone or intent unless doing so is necessary for clarity.

skills.name: Improve structure
skills.description: Reorganize a document using clearer Markdown and appropriate components.

skills.name: Rewrite
skills.description: Rewrite selected content with more natural wording and flow.
skills.prompt:
Rewrite the selected content so it reads more naturally and effectively.

Preserve the original meaning, intent, important details, terminology, and approximate tone.

Improve wording, sentence construction, and flow where useful.

Do not make the text substantially longer or shorter unless that is necessary to produce a better rewrite.

skills.name: Shorten
skills.description: Make selected content shorter without losing important meaning.
skills.prompt:
Shorten the selected content while preserving its important meaning and intent.

Remove repetition, filler, unnecessary qualifiers, redundant examples, and overly verbose phrasing.

Prefer concise, direct language.

Do not remove information that materially changes the meaning, introduces ambiguity, or makes the text misleading.

skills.name: Expand
skills.description: Develop selected content with supported context and detail.
skills.prompt:
Expand the selected content into a fuller and more useful version.

Add explanation, context, transitions, or supporting detail where these can be reasonably derived from the existing text.

Make the content feel intentionally developed rather than artificially padded.

Do not invent facts, statistics, claims, sources, examples, policies, or other information that is not supported by the supplied content.

Preserve the original meaning, tone, and intent.

skills.name: Turn into bullet points
skills.description: Convert selected content into a concise Markdown bullet list.
skills.prompt:
Rewrite the selected content as a clear, concise Markdown bullet list.

Identify the distinct ideas, requirements, steps, arguments, or pieces of information in the selection and give each an appropriate bullet.

Keep bullets parallel in style and reasonably concise.

Preserve important meaning and detail, but remove prose that is only needed to connect sentences together.

Use nested bullets only when there is a genuine parent-child relationship between ideas.

Do not add new information.
